title: Ted Owens, 'Mr PK', claimed to be a biological sensor of UFOs

tellings.quote: he wrote about a guy named Mr PK tetto and tedo and claimed to be a almost a biological censor of UFOs

plain: A man named Ted Owens, who called himself "Mr PK" (PK stands for psychokinesis, moving things with the mind), claimed to be almost a living sensor for UFOs. Michels brings it up while talking with the UFO researcher Jacques Vallee, saying a writer named Jeffrey Mishlove wrote about Owens. If true, it would suggest UFOs can be tied to particular people and their minds.
